(() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('.picker .fchip')].find((x) => x.textContent.startsWith('Unknown')); if (!f) return 'NOT FOUND'; f.click(); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('.picker .card:not(.cur)')].find((x) => x.querySelector('.pstat')?.textContent === "DLC unknown"); if (!c) return 'NOT FOUND'; c.click(); return 'ok'; })()
